-- Copyright (c) 2024 Digital Asset (Switzerland) GmbH and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

module Splice.Scripts.TestSplitwell where

import Splice.Splitwell
import Splice.Scripts.TestWallet

import DA.Action
import DA.Foldable (forA_)
import DA.List (sort)
import DA.Map (Map)
import qualified DA.Map as M
import DA.Assert
import DA.Time
import Daml.Script
import Splice.Scripts.Util
import Splice.Wallet.Payment


createSplitwellRules : AmuletUser -> Script (ContractId SplitwellRules)
createSplitwellRules provider = do
  submit provider.primaryParty $ createCmd SplitwellRules with provider = provider.primaryParty, ..

requestGroup : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Text -> Script (ContractId GroupRequest)
requestGroup app p provider id =
  exerciseSplitwellRules p provider $ SplitwellRules_RequestGroup with
    group =Group with
      owner = p.primaryParty
      provider = provider.primaryParty
      members = []
      id = GroupId id
      dso = app.dso
      acceptDuration = minutes 5
    user = p.primaryParty

getSplitwellRules : AmuletUser -> Script (ContractId SplitwellRules)
getSplitwellRules provider = do
  rules <- queryFilter @SplitwellRules provider.primaryParty (\rule -> rule.provider == provider.primaryParty)
  case rules of
    [(rule, _)] -> pure rule
    _ -> abort $ "Expected exactly one SplitwellRules but got " <> show rules

exerciseSplitwellRules : Choice SplitwellRules c r => AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> c -> Script r
exerciseSplitwellRules user provider arg = exerciseSplitwellRules' user provider [] arg


exerciseSplitwellRules' : Choice SplitwellRules c r => AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> [Party] -> c -> Script r
exerciseSplitwellRules' user provider readAs arg = do
  rule <- getSplitwellRules provider
  submitMulti [user.primaryParty] (provider.primaryParty :: readAs) $ exerciseCmd rule arg

getGroup : AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (ContractId Group)
getGroup user k = do
  groups <- queryFilter @Group user.primaryParty (\g -> getGroupKey g == k)
  case groups of
    [(group, _)] -> pure group
    _ -> abort $ "Expected exactly one Group but got " <> show groups

createInvite : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (ContractId GroupInvite)
createInvite owner provider groupKey = do
  group <- getGroup owner groupKey
  exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider SplitwellRules_CreateInvite with user = owner.primaryParty, ..

acceptInvite : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Party -> ContractId GroupInvite ->  Script (ContractId AcceptedGroupInvite)
acceptInvite invitee provider groupOwner inviteCid = do
  -- No explicit disclosure support in Daml script so we do readAs as the group owner.
  exerciseSplitwellRules' invitee provider [groupOwner] $ SplitwellRules_AcceptInvite with
    cid = inviteCid
    user = invitee.primaryParty

joinAllInvites : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Script ()
joinAllInvites owner provider = do
  acceptedInvites <- queryFilter @AcceptedGroupInvite owner.primaryParty (\c -> c.groupKey.owner == owner.primaryParty)
  forA_ acceptedInvites $ \(cid, invite) -> do
    group <- getGroup owner (groupKey invite)
    exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider $ SplitwellRules_Join with
      group
      cid
      user = owner.primaryParty

net : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Map Party (Map Party Decimal) -> Script (ContractId BalanceUpdate)
net owner provider groupKey balanceChanges = do
  group <- getGroup owner groupKey
  exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider SplitwellRules_Net with
    user = owner.primaryParty
    ..


-- | Query all balances for the current party in the given group.
-- Returns a map from parties to their balance in relation to the given party.
-- Positive: They owe you, negative: you owe them.
queryBalances : AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (Map Party Decimal)
queryBalances p k = do
    updates <- queryFilter @BalanceUpdate p.primaryParty (\u -> getGroupKey u.group == k)
    pure $ M.filter (/= 0.0) $ foldl f M.empty (map snd updates)
  where
    f acc BalanceUpdate{..} = case update of
      ExternalPayment {..} ->
        let split = amount / intToNumeric (length group.members + 1) -- TODO(#1451) Make sure nothing gets lost here.
        in if payer == p.primaryParty
             then let g acc x
                        | x == payer = acc
                        | otherwise = M.insertWith (+) x split acc
                  in foldl g acc (group.owner :: group.members)
             else M.insertWith (+) payer (-split) acc
      Transfer {..}
        | p.primaryParty == sender -> M.insertWith (+) receiver amount acc
        | p.primaryParty == receiver -> M.insertWith (+) sender (- amount) acc
        | otherwise -> acc
      Netting {..} -> case M.lookup p.primaryParty balanceChanges of
        None -> acc
        Some changes -> foldl (\acc (p', v) -> M.insertWith (+) p' v acc) acc (M.toList changes)
      ExtBalanceUpdateType _dummyUnitField -> error "ExtBalanceUpdate: bare extension constructors are not allowed at runtime"

enterPayment : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Decimal -> Text -> Script ()
enterPayment payer provider groupKey amount description = do
  group <- getGroup payer groupKey
  void $ exerciseSplitwellRules payer provider $ SplitwellRules_EnterPayment with user = payer.primaryParty, ..

initiateTransfer : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> [ReceiverAmuletAmount] -> Script (ContractId AppPaymentRequest)
initiateTransfer sender provider groupKey receiverAmounts = do
  group <- getGroup sender groupKey
  (_, request) <- exerciseSplitwellRules sender provider SplitwellRules_InitiateTransfer with user = sender.primaryParty, ..
  pure request

completeTransfer : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> ContractId AcceptedAppPayment -> Script ()
completeTransfer app provider acceptedPaymentCid = do
  transferContext <- getAppTransferContext app provider
  Some AcceptedAppPayment{reference} <- queryContractId provider.primaryParty acceptedPaymentCid
  [(transferInProgress, _)] <- queryFilter @TransferInProgress provider.primaryParty (\c -> c.reference == reference)
  void $ submitUser provider.userId $ exerciseCmd transferInProgress TransferInProgress_CompleteTransfer with ..

test : Script ()
test = script do
  DefaultAppWithUsers{..} <- setupDefaultAppWithUsers
  runNextIssuance app
  runAmuletDepositBots app

  featureApp app provider1

  testCase app Parties with
    provider = provider1
    getValidator = const provider1Validator.primaryParty
    ..

-- | Parties used in the test.
data Parties = Parties
  with
    alice : AmuletUser
    bob : AmuletUser
    charlie : AmuletUser
    provider : AmuletUser
    getValidator : AmuletUser -> Party

testCase : AmuletApp -> Parties -> Script ()
testCase app Parties{..} = do
  createSplitwellRules provider

  groupRequestCid <- requestGroup app alice provider "group0"
  submit provider.primaryParty $ exerciseCmd groupRequestCid GroupRequest_Accept
  let groupKey = GroupKey alice.primaryParty provider.primaryParty (GroupId "group0")
  groupInviteCid <- createInvite alice provider groupKey

  acceptInvite bob provider alice.primaryParty groupInviteCid
  joinAllInvites alice provider

  acceptInvite charlie provider alice.primaryParty groupInviteCid
  joinAllInvites alice provider

  Some group <- queryContractId alice.primaryParty =<< getGroup alice groupKey
  sort group.members === [bob.primaryParty, charlie.primaryParty]

  balance <- queryBalances alice (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.empty
  balance <- queryBalances bob (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.empty
  balance <- queryBalances charlie (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.empty

  enterPayment alice provider (getGroupKey group) 63.0 "foo"

  balance <- queryBalances alice (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(bob.primaryParty, 21.0), (charlie.primaryParty, 21.0)]
  balance <- queryBalances bob (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(alice.primaryParty, -21.0)]
  balance <- queryBalances charlie (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(alice.primaryParty, -21.0)]

  enterPayment bob provider (getGroupKey group) 33.0 "foo"
  balance <- queryBalances alice (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(bob.primaryParty, 10.0), (charlie.primaryParty, 21.0)]
  balance <- queryBalances bob (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(alice.primaryParty, -10.0), (charlie.primaryParty, 11.0)]
  balance <- queryBalances charlie (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(alice.primaryParty, -21.0), (bob.primaryParty, -11.0)]

  request <- initiateTransfer alice provider (getGroupKey group) [ReceiverAmuletAmount bob.primaryParty 8.0]
  amulet <- tap app alice 63.0
  receipt <- acceptPaymentRequest app alice (getValidator alice) None request amulet

  completeTransfer app provider receipt

  balance <- queryBalances alice (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(bob.primaryParty, 18.0), (charlie.primaryParty, 21.0)]
  balance <- queryBalances bob (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(alice.primaryParty, -18.0), (charlie.primaryParty, 11.0)]
  balance <- queryBalances charlie (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(alice.primaryParty, -21.0), (bob.primaryParty, -11.0)]

  request <- initiateTransfer charlie provider (getGroupKey group) [
      ReceiverAmuletAmount alice.primaryParty 39.0,
      ReceiverAmuletAmount bob.primaryParty 11.0
    ]
  amulet <- tap app charlie 55.0
  receipt <- acceptPaymentRequest app charlie (getValidator charlie) None request amulet
  completeTransfer app provider receipt

  balance <- queryBalances alice (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(bob.primaryParty, 18.0), (charlie.primaryParty, -18.0)]
  balance <- queryBalances bob (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(alice.primaryParty, -18.0)]
  balance <- queryBalances charlie (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(alice.primaryParty, 18.0)]

  net alice provider (getGroupKey group) $ M.fromList
    [ (alice.primaryParty, M.fromList [(bob.primaryParty, -18.0), (charlie.primaryParty, 18.0)])
    , (bob.primaryParty, M.fromList [(alice.primaryParty, 18.0), (charlie.primaryParty, -18.0)])
    , (charlie.primaryParty, M.fromList [(alice.primaryParty, -18.0), (bob.primaryParty, 18.0)])
    ]

  balance <- queryBalances alice (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.empty
  balance <- queryBalances bob (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(charlie.primaryParty, -18.0)]
  balance <- queryBalances charlie (getGroupKey group)
  balance === M.fromList [(bob.primaryParty, 18.0)]

  pure ()

createSplitwellRules : AmuletUser -> Script (ContractId SplitwellRules)
createSplitwellRules provider = do
  submit provider.primaryParty $ createCmd SplitwellRules with provider = provider.primaryParty, ..

requestGroup : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Text -> Script (ContractId GroupRequest)
requestGroup app p provider id =
  exerciseSplitwellRules p provider $ SplitwellRules_RequestGroup with
    group =Group with
      owner = p.primaryParty
      provider = provider.primaryParty
      members = []
      id = GroupId id
      dso = app.dso
      acceptDuration = minutes 5
    user = p.primaryParty

getSplitwellRules : AmuletUser -> Script (ContractId SplitwellRules)
getSplitwellRules provider = do
  rules <- queryFilter @SplitwellRules provider.primaryParty (\rule -> rule.provider == provider.primaryParty)
  case rules of
    [(rule, _)] -> pure rule
    _ -> abort $ "Expected exactly one SplitwellRules but got " <> show rules

exerciseSplitwellRules : Choice SplitwellRules c r => AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> c -> Script r
exerciseSplitwellRules user provider arg = exerciseSplitwellRules' user provider [] arg

  groups <- queryFilter @Group user.primaryParty (\g -> getGroupKey g == k)
  case groups of
    [(group, _)] -> pure group
    _ -> abort $ "Expected exactly one Group but got " <> show groups

createInvite : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (ContractId GroupInvite)
createInvite owner provider groupKey = do

acceptInvite : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Party -> ContractId GroupInvite ->  Script (ContractId AcceptedGroupInvite)

    cid = inviteCid
    user = invitee.primaryParty

joinAllInvites owner provider = do
  acceptedInvites <- queryFilter @AcceptedGroupInvite owner.primaryParty (\c -> c.groupKey.owner == owner.primaryParty)

      user = owner.primaryParty

createSplitwellRules : AmuletUser -> Script (ContractId SplitwellRules)
createSplitwellRules provider = do
  submit provider.primaryParty $ createCmd SplitwellRules with provider = provider.primaryParty, ..

requestGroup : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Text -> Script (ContractId GroupRequest)
requestGroup app p provider id =
  exerciseSplitwellRules p provider $ SplitwellRules_RequestGroup with
    group =Group with
      owner = p.primaryParty
      provider = provider.primaryParty
      members = []
      id = GroupId id
      dso = app.dso
      acceptDuration = minutes 5
    user = p.primaryParty

getSplitwellRules : AmuletUser -> Script (ContractId SplitwellRules)
getSplitwellRules provider = do
  rules <- queryFilter @SplitwellRules provider.primaryParty (\rule -> rule.provider == provider.primaryParty)
  case rules of
    [(rule, _)] -> pure rule
    _ -> abort $ "Expected exactly one SplitwellRules but got " <> show rules

exerciseSplitwellRules : Choice SplitwellRules c r => AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> c -> Script r
exerciseSplitwellRules user provider arg = exerciseSplitwellRules' user provider [] arg


exerciseSplitwellRules' : Choice SplitwellRules c r => AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> [Party] -> c -> Script r
exerciseSplitwellRules' user provider readAs arg = do
  rule <- getSplitwellRules provider
  submitMulti [user.primaryParty] (provider.primaryParty :: readAs) $ exerciseCmd rule arg

getGroup : AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (ContractId Group)
getGroup user k = do
  groups <- queryFilter @Group user.primaryParty (\g -> getGroupKey g == k)
  case groups of
    [(group, _)] -> pure group
    _ -> abort $ "Expected exactly one Group but got " <> show groups

createInvite : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (ContractId GroupInvite)
createInvite owner provider groupKey = do
  group <- getGroup owner groupKey
  exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider SplitwellRules_CreateInvite with user = owner.primaryParty, ..

acceptInvite : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Party -> ContractId GroupInvite ->  Script (ContractId AcceptedGroupInvite)
acceptInvite invitee provider groupOwner inviteCid = do
  -- No explicit disclosure support in Daml script so we do readAs as the group owner.
  exerciseSplitwellRules' invitee provider [groupOwner] $ SplitwellRules_AcceptInvite with
    cid = inviteCid
    user = invitee.primaryParty

joinAllInvites : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Script ()
joinAllInvites owner provider = do
  acceptedInvites <- queryFilter @AcceptedGroupInvite owner.primaryParty (\c -> c.groupKey.owner == owner.primaryParty)
  forA_ acceptedInvites $ \(cid, invite) -> do
    group <- getGroup owner (groupKey invite)
    exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider $ SplitwellRules_Join with
      group
      cid
      user = owner.primaryParty

net : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Map Party (Map Party Decimal) -> Script (ContractId BalanceUpdate)
net owner provider groupKey balanceChanges = do
  group <- getGroup owner groupKey
  exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider SplitwellRules_Net with
    user = owner.primaryParty
    ..


-- | Query all balances for the current party in the given group.
-- Returns a map from parties to their balance in relation to the given party.
-- Positive: They owe you, negative: you owe them.
queryBalances : AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (Map Party Decimal)
queryBalances p k = do
    updates <- queryFilter @BalanceUpdate p.primaryParty (\u -> getGroupKey u.group == k)
    pure $ M.filter (/= 0.0) $ foldl f M.empty (map snd updates)
  where
    f acc BalanceUpdate{..} = case update of
      ExternalPayment {..} ->
        let split = amount / intToNumeric (length group.members + 1) -- TODO(#1451) Make sure nothing gets lost here.
        in if payer == p.primaryParty
             then let g acc x
                        | x == payer = acc
                        | otherwise = M.insertWith (+) x split acc
                  in foldl g acc (group.owner :: group.members)
             else M.insertWith (+) payer (-split) acc
      Transfer {..}
        | p.primaryParty == sender -> M.insertWith (+) receiver amount acc
        | p.primaryParty == receiver -> M.insertWith (+) sender (- amount) acc
        | otherwise -> acc
      Netting {..} -> case M.lookup p.primaryParty balanceChanges of
        None -> acc
        Some changes -> foldl (\acc (p', v) -> M.insertWith (+) p' v acc) acc (M.toList changes)
      ExtBalanceUpdateType _dummyUnitField -> error "ExtBalanceUpdate: bare extension constructors are not allowed at runtime"

enterPayment : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Decimal -> Text -> Script ()
enterPayment payer provider groupKey amount description = do
  group <- getGroup payer groupKey
  void $ exerciseSplitwellRules payer provider $ SplitwellRules_EnterPayment with user = payer.primaryParty, ..

initiateTransfer : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> [ReceiverAmuletAmount] -> Script (ContractId AppPaymentRequest)
initiateTransfer sender provider groupKey receiverAmounts = do
  group <- getGroup sender groupKey
  (_, request) <- exerciseSplitwellRules sender provider SplitwellRules_InitiateTransfer with user = sender.primaryParty, ..
  pure request

completeTransfer : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> ContractId AcceptedAppPayment -> Script ()
completeTransfer app provider acceptedPaymentCid = do
  transferContext <- getAppTransferContext app provider
  Some AcceptedAppPayment{reference} <- queryContractId provider.primaryParty acceptedPaymentCid
  [(transferInProgress, _)] <- queryFilter @TransferInProgress provider.primaryParty (\c -> c.reference == reference)
  void $ submitUser provider.userId $ exerciseCmd transferInProgress TransferInProgress_CompleteTransfer with ..

test : Script ()
test = script do
  DefaultAppWithUsers{..} <- setupDefaultAppWithUsers
  runNextIssuance app
  runAmuletDepositBots app

  featureApp app provider1

  testCase app Parties with
    provider = provider1
    getValidator = const provider1Validator.primaryParty
    ..

module Splice.Scripts.TestSplitwell where

import Splice.Splitwell
import Splice.Scripts.TestWallet

import DA.Action
import DA.Foldable (forA_)
import DA.List (sort)
import DA.Map (Map)
import qualified DA.Map as M
import DA.Assert
import DA.Time
import Daml.Script
import Splice.Scripts.Util
import Splice.Wallet.Payment


createSplitwellRules : AmuletUser -> Script (ContractId SplitwellRules)
createSplitwellRules provider = do
  submit provider.primaryParty $ createCmd SplitwellRules with provider = provider.primaryParty, ..

requestGroup : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Text -> Script (ContractId GroupRequest)
requestGroup app p provider id =
  exerciseSplitwellRules p provider $ SplitwellRules_RequestGroup with
    group =Group with
      owner = p.primaryParty
      provider = provider.primaryParty
      members = []
      id = GroupId id
      dso = app.dso
      acceptDuration = minutes 5
    user = p.primaryParty

getSplitwellRules : AmuletUser -> Script (ContractId SplitwellRules)
getSplitwellRules provider = do
  rules <- queryFilter @SplitwellRules provider.primaryParty (\rule -> rule.provider == provider.primaryParty)
  case rules of
    [(rule, _)] -> pure rule
    _ -> abort $ "Expected exactly one SplitwellRules but got " <> show rules

exerciseSplitwellRules : Choice SplitwellRules c r => AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> c -> Script r
exerciseSplitwellRules user provider arg = exerciseSplitwellRules' user provider [] arg


exerciseSplitwellRules' : Choice SplitwellRules c r => AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> [Party] -> c -> Script r
exerciseSplitwellRules' user provider readAs arg = do
  rule <- getSplitwellRules provider
  submitMulti [user.primaryParty] (provider.primaryParty :: readAs) $ exerciseCmd rule arg

getGroup : AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (ContractId Group)
getGroup user k = do
  groups <- queryFilter @Group user.primaryParty (\g -> getGroupKey g == k)
  case groups of
    [(group, _)] -> pure group
    _ -> abort $ "Expected exactly one Group but got " <> show groups

createInvite : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (ContractId GroupInvite)
createInvite owner provider groupKey = do
  group <- getGroup owner groupKey
  exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider SplitwellRules_CreateInvite with user = owner.primaryParty, ..

acceptInvite : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Party -> ContractId GroupInvite ->  Script (ContractId AcceptedGroupInvite)
acceptInvite invitee provider groupOwner inviteCid = do
  -- No explicit disclosure support in Daml script so we do readAs as the group owner.
  exerciseSplitwellRules' invitee provider [groupOwner] $ SplitwellRules_AcceptInvite with
    cid = inviteCid
    user = invitee.primaryParty

joinAllInvites : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Script ()
joinAllInvites owner provider = do
  acceptedInvites <- queryFilter @AcceptedGroupInvite owner.primaryParty (\c -> c.groupKey.owner == owner.primaryParty)
  forA_ acceptedInvites $ \(cid, invite) -> do
    group <- getGroup owner (groupKey invite)
    exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider $ SplitwellRules_Join with
      group
      cid
      user = owner.primaryParty

net : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Map Party (Map Party Decimal) -> Script (ContractId BalanceUpdate)
net owner provider groupKey balanceChanges = do
  group <- getGroup owner groupKey
  exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider SplitwellRules_Net with
    user = owner.primaryParty
    ..


-- | Query all balances for the current party in the given group.
-- Returns a map from parties to their balance in relation to the given party.
-- Positive: They owe you, negative: you owe them.
queryBalances : AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (Map Party Decimal)
queryBalances p k = do
    updates <- queryFilter @BalanceUpdate p.primaryParty (\u -> getGroupKey u.group == k)
    pure $ M.filter (/= 0.0) $ foldl f M.empty (map snd updates)
  where
    f acc BalanceUpdate{..} = case update of
      ExternalPayment {..} ->
        let split = amount / intToNumeric (length group.members + 1) -- TODO(#1451) Make sure nothing gets lost here.
        in if payer == p.primaryParty
             then let g acc x
                        | x == payer = acc
                        | otherwise = M.insertWith (+) x split acc
                  in foldl g acc (group.owner :: group.members)
             else M.insertWith (+) payer (-split) acc
      Transfer {..}
        | p.primaryParty == sender -> M.insertWith (+) receiver amount acc
        | p.primaryParty == receiver -> M.insertWith (+) sender (- amount) acc
        | otherwise -> acc
      Netting {..} -> case M.lookup p.primaryParty balanceChanges of
        None -> acc
        Some changes -> foldl (\acc (p', v) -> M.insertWith (+) p' v acc) acc (M.toList changes)
      ExtBalanceUpdateType _dummyUnitField -> error "ExtBalanceUpdate: bare extension constructors are not allowed at runtime"

enterPayment : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Decimal -> Text -> Script ()
enterPayment payer provider groupKey amount description = do
  group <- getGroup payer groupKey
  void $ exerciseSplitwellRules payer provider $ SplitwellRules_EnterPayment with user = payer.primaryParty, ..

initiateTransfer : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> [ReceiverAmuletAmount] -> Script (ContractId AppPaymentRequest)
initiateTransfer sender provider groupKey receiverAmounts = do
  group <- getGroup sender groupKey
  (_, request) <- exerciseSplitwellRules sender provider SplitwellRules_InitiateTransfer with user = sender.primaryParty, ..
  pure request

completeTransfer : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> ContractId AcceptedAppPayment -> Script ()
completeTransfer app provider acceptedPaymentCid = do
  transferContext <- getAppTransferContext app provider
  Some AcceptedAppPayment{reference} <- queryContractId provider.primaryParty acceptedPaymentCid
  [(transferInProgress, _)] <- queryFilter @TransferInProgress provider.primaryParty (\c -> c.reference == reference)
  void $ submitUser provider.userId $ exerciseCmd transferInProgress TransferInProgress_CompleteTransfer with ..

test : Script ()
test = script do
  DefaultAppWithUsers{..} <- setupDefaultAppWithUsers
  runNextIssuance app
  runAmuletDepositBots app

  featureApp app provider1

  testCase app Parties with
    provider = provider1
    getValidator = const provider1Validator.primaryParty
    ..

-- | Parties used in the test.
data Parties = Parties
  with
    alice : AmuletUser
    bob : AmuletUser
    charlie : AmuletUser
    provider : AmuletUser
    getValidator : AmuletUser -> Party

import DA.Foldable (forA_)
import DA.List (sort)
import DA.Map (Map)
import qualified DA.Map as M
import DA.Assert
import DA.Time
import Daml.Script
import Splice.Scripts.Util
import Splice.Wallet.Payment


createSplitwellRules : AmuletUser -> Script (ContractId SplitwellRules)
createSplitwellRules provider = do
  submit provider.primaryParty $ createCmd SplitwellRules with provider = provider.primaryParty, ..

requestGroup : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Text -> Script (ContractId GroupRequest)
requestGroup app p provider id =
  exerciseSplitwellRules p provider $ SplitwellRules_RequestGroup with
    group =Group with
      owner = p.primaryParty
      provider = provider.primaryParty
      members = []
      id = GroupId id
      dso = app.dso
      acceptDuration = minutes 5
    user = p.primaryParty

getSplitwellRules : AmuletUser -> Script (ContractId SplitwellRules)
getSplitwellRules provider = do
  rules <- queryFilter @SplitwellRules provider.primaryParty (\rule -> rule.provider == provider.primaryParty)
  case rules of
    [(rule, _)] -> pure rule
    _ -> abort $ "Expected exactly one SplitwellRules but got " <> show rules

exerciseSplitwellRules : Choice SplitwellRules c r => AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> c -> Script r
exerciseSplitwellRules user provider arg = exerciseSplitwellRules' user provider [] arg


exerciseSplitwellRules' : Choice SplitwellRules c r => AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> [Party] -> c -> Script r
exerciseSplitwellRules' user provider readAs arg = do
  rule <- getSplitwellRules provider
  submitMulti [user.primaryParty] (provider.primaryParty :: readAs) $ exerciseCmd rule arg

getGroup : AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (ContractId Group)
getGroup user k = do
  groups <- queryFilter @Group user.primaryParty (\g -> getGroupKey g == k)
  case groups of
    [(group, _)] -> pure group
    _ -> abort $ "Expected exactly one Group but got " <> show groups

createInvite : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (ContractId GroupInvite)
createInvite owner provider groupKey = do
  group <- getGroup owner groupKey
  exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider SplitwellRules_CreateInvite with user = owner.primaryParty, ..

acceptInvite : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Party -> ContractId GroupInvite ->  Script (ContractId AcceptedGroupInvite)
acceptInvite invitee provider groupOwner inviteCid = do
  -- No explicit disclosure support in Daml script so we do readAs as the group owner.
  exerciseSplitwellRules' invitee provider [groupOwner] $ SplitwellRules_AcceptInvite with
    cid = inviteCid
    user = invitee.primaryParty

joinAllInvites : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> Script ()
joinAllInvites owner provider = do
  acceptedInvites <- queryFilter @AcceptedGroupInvite owner.primaryParty (\c -> c.groupKey.owner == owner.primaryParty)
  forA_ acceptedInvites $ \(cid, invite) -> do
    group <- getGroup owner (groupKey invite)
    exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider $ SplitwellRules_Join with
      group
      cid
      user = owner.primaryParty

net : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Map Party (Map Party Decimal) -> Script (ContractId BalanceUpdate)
net owner provider groupKey balanceChanges = do
  group <- getGroup owner groupKey
  exerciseSplitwellRules owner provider SplitwellRules_Net with
    user = owner.primaryParty
    ..


-- | Query all balances for the current party in the given group.
-- Returns a map from parties to their balance in relation to the given party.
-- Positive: They owe you, negative: you owe them.
queryBalances : AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Script (Map Party Decimal)
queryBalances p k = do
    updates <- queryFilter @BalanceUpdate p.primaryParty (\u -> getGroupKey u.group == k)
    pure $ M.filter (/= 0.0) $ foldl f M.empty (map snd updates)
  where
    f acc BalanceUpdate{..} = case update of
      ExternalPayment {..} ->
        let split = amount / intToNumeric (length group.members + 1) -- TODO(#1451) Make sure nothing gets lost here.
        in if payer == p.primaryParty
             then let g acc x
                        | x == payer = acc
                        | otherwise = M.insertWith (+) x split acc
                  in foldl g acc (group.owner :: group.members)
             else M.insertWith (+) payer (-split) acc
      Transfer {..}
        | p.primaryParty == sender -> M.insertWith (+) receiver amount acc
        | p.primaryParty == receiver -> M.insertWith (+) sender (- amount) acc
        | otherwise -> acc
      Netting {..} -> case M.lookup p.primaryParty balanceChanges of
        None -> acc
        Some changes -> foldl (\acc (p', v) -> M.insertWith (+) p' v acc) acc (M.toList changes)
      ExtBalanceUpdateType _dummyUnitField -> error "ExtBalanceUpdate: bare extension constructors are not allowed at runtime"

enterPayment : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> Decimal -> Text -> Script ()
enterPayment payer provider groupKey amount description = do
  group <- getGroup payer groupKey
  void $ exerciseSplitwellRules payer provider $ SplitwellRules_EnterPayment with user = payer.primaryParty, ..

initiateTransfer : AmuletUser -> AmuletUser -> GroupKey -> [ReceiverAmuletAmount] -> Script (ContractId AppPaymentRequest)
initiateTransfer sender provider groupKey receiverAmounts = do
  group <- getGroup sender groupKey
  (_, request) <- exerciseSplitwellRules sender provider SplitwellRules_InitiateTransfer with user = sender.primaryParty, ..
  pure request

completeTransfer : AmuletApp -> AmuletUser -> ContractId AcceptedAppPayment -> Script ()
completeTransfer app provider acceptedPaymentCid = do
  transferContext <- getAppTransferContext app provider
  Some AcceptedAppPayment{reference} <- queryContractId provider.primaryParty acceptedPaymentCid
  [(transferInProgress, _)] <- queryFilter @TransferInProgress provider.primaryParty (\c -> c.reference == reference)
  void $ submitUser provider.userId $ exerciseCmd transferInProgress TransferInProgress_CompleteTransfer with ..

test : Script ()
test = script do
  DefaultAppWithUsers{..} <- setupDefaultAppWithUsers
  runNextIssuance app
  runAmuletDepositBots app

  featureApp app provider1

  testCase app Parties with
    provider = provider1
    getValidator = const provider1Validator.primaryParty
    ..

-- | Parties used in the test.
data Parties = Parties
  with
    alice : AmuletUser
    bob : AmuletUser
    charlie : AmuletUser
    provider : AmuletUser
    getValidator : AmuletUser -> Party

summary:
**Clarifying signatory roles**

I'm considering the roles and responsibilities of signatory providers and owners during user exercises. It seems like the signatory provider should represent the observer group participants effectively. I want to ensure that the group has a clearly defined owner who can guide the provider and observer members to maintain visibility. I’m curious about how transfers will work through progress and if the signatory provider will act as the sender in these instances.

**Understanding payment collection**

I'm exploring how an accepted app payment collection works. It seems all receiver signatories and the sender provider must be involved for the transfer to progress. If a provider doesn't have them, it complicates things. The control provider has to manage the collection process, but it can't happen alone. I wonder if I can fetch accepted payments to create visibility and check references. Also, authorization from the receiver signatories is crucial for creating the AppPaymentRequest.

**Testing payment requests**

I'm wondering if I can set the receiver amounts for just the receiver provider. +    dso : Party
+    acceptDuration : RelTime

+
+    key GroupKey owner provider id : GroupKey
+    maintainer key.owner
+
+    choice Group_Replace : ContractId Group
+      with newMember : Party

+      do
+        archive self

+

+  with group : Group
+  where
+    signatory group.owner
+    observer group.provider
+

+  deriving (Eq, Show)
+

+  with
+    group : Group
+    update : BalanceUpdateType
+  where
+    signatory group.provider
+    observer group.owner, group.members

+  with
+    group : Group

+    sender : Party
+    receiverAmounts : [ReceiverAmuletAmount]
+    provider : Party

+      with
+        group : ContractId Group
+        user : Party
+        amount : Decimal
+        description : Text
+      controller user
+      do
+        current <- fetch group
+        assert (current.provider == provider && user "'`elem` (current.owner :: current.members))
+        create BalanceUpdate with
+          group = current
+          update = ExternalPayment with payer = user; amount; description
+
+    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_Net : ContractId BalanceUpdate
+      with
+        group : ContractId Group
+        user : Party
+        balanceChanges : Map Party (Map Party Decimal)
+      controller user
+      do
+        current <- fetch group
+        assert (current.owner == user && current.provider == provider)
+        create BalanceUpdate with group = current; update = Netting with balanceChanges
+
+    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_InitiateTransfer : (ContractId TransferInProgress, ContractId AppPaymentRequest)
+      with
+        group : ContractId Group
+        user : Party
+        receiverAmounts : [ReceiverAmuletAmount]
+      controller user
+      do
+        current <- fetch group
+        assert (current.provider == provider && user `elem` (current.owner :: current.members))
+        assert (all ('"\\entry -> entry.receiver "'`elem` (current.owner :: current.members)) receiverAmounts)
+        now <- getTime
+        request <- create AppPaymentRequest with
+          sender = user
+          receiverAmounts = [ReceiverAmount provider (PaymentAmount (foldl ('"\\total entry -> total + entry.amuletAmount) 0.0 receiverAmounts) AmuletUnit)]
+          provider
+          dso = current.dso
+          expiresAt = addRelTime now (minutes 5)
+          description = \"Splitwell transfer\"
+        progress <- create TransferInProgress with
+          group = current
+          reference = request
+          sender = user
+          receiverAmounts
+          provider
+        pure (progress, request)
*** End Patch

module Splice.Splitwell where

import DA.Map (Map)
import DA.Time (addRelTime, minutes)
import Splice.AmuletRules (AppTransferContext)
import Splice.Wallet.Payment

newtype GroupId = GroupId Text deriving (Eq, Show, Ord)

data GroupKey = GroupKey with
  owner : Party
  provider : Party
  id : GroupId
  deriving (Eq, Show, Ord)

getGroupKey : Group -> GroupKey
getGroupKey group = GroupKey group.owner group.provider group.id

template Group
  with
    owner : Party
    provider : Party
    members : [Party]
    id : GroupId
    dso : Party
    acceptDuration : RelTime
  where
    signatory owner, provider
    observer members

    key GroupKey owner provider id : GroupKey
    maintainer key.owner

    choice Group_Replace : ContractId Group
      with newMember : Party
      controller owner
      do
        archive self
        create this with members = members ++ [newMember]

template GroupRequest
  with group : Group
  where
    signatory group.owner
    observer group.provider

    choice GroupRequest_Accept : ContractId Group
      controller group.provider
      do create group

template GroupInvite
  with groupKey : GroupKey
  where
    signatory groupKey.owner
    observer groupKey.provider

template AcceptedGroupInvite
  with
    groupKey : GroupKey
    invitee : Party
  where
    signatory invitee
    observer groupKey.owner, groupKey.provider

data BalanceUpdateType
  = ExternalPayment with payer : Party; amount : Decimal; description : Text
  | Transfer with sender : Party; receiver : Party; amount : Decimal
  | Netting with balanceChanges : Map Party (Map Party Decimal)
  | ExtBalanceUpdateType with _dummyUnitField : ()
  deriving (Eq, Show)

template BalanceUpdate
  with
    group : Group
    update : BalanceUpdateType
  where
    signatory group.provider
    observer group.owner, group.members

template TransferInProgress
  with
    group : Group
    reference : ContractId AppPaymentRequest
    sender : Party
    receiverAmounts : [ReceiverAmuletAmount]
    provider : Party
  where
    signatory provider
    observer sender, group.owner, group.members

    choice TransferInProgress_CompleteTransfer : [ContractId BalanceUpdate]
      with transferContext : AppTransferContext
      controller provider
      do
        forA receiverAmounts "'$ '"\\ReceiverAmuletAmount{..} ->
          create BalanceUpdate with
            group
            update = Transfer with sender; receiver; amount = amuletAmount

template SplitwellRules
  with provider : Party
  where
    signatory provider

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_RequestGroup : ContractId GroupRequest
      with
        group : Group
        user : Party
      controller user
      do
        assert (group.owner == user && group.provider == provider)
        create GroupRequest with group

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_CreateInvite : ContractId GroupInvite
      with
        group : ContractId Group
        user : Party
      controller user
      do
        current <- fetch group
        assert (current.owner == user && current.provider == provider)
        create GroupInvite with groupKey = getGroupKey current

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_AcceptInvite : ContractId AcceptedGroupInvite
      with
        cid : ContractId GroupInvite
        user : Party
      controller user
      do
        invite <- fetch cid
        assert (invite.groupKey.provider == provider)
        create AcceptedGroupInvite with groupKey = invite.groupKey; invitee = user

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_Join : ContractId Group
      with
        group : ContractId Group
        cid : ContractId AcceptedGroupInvite
        user : Party
      controller user
      do
        accepted <- fetch cid
        current <- fetch group
        assert (current.owner == user && current.provider == provider)
        assert (accepted.groupKey == getGroupKey current)
        exercise group (Group_Replace accepted.invitee)

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_EnterPayment : ContractId BalanceUpdate
      with
        group : ContractId Group
        user : Party
        amount : Decimal
        description : Text
      controller user
      do
        current <- fetch group
        assert (current.provider == provider && user "'`elem` (current.owner :: current.members))
        create BalanceUpdate with
          group = current
          update = ExternalPayment with payer = user; amount; description

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_Net : ContractId BalanceUpdate
      with
        group : ContractId Group
        user : Party
        balanceChanges : Map Party (Map Party Decimal)
      controller user
      do
        current <- fetch group
        assert (current.owner == user && current.provider == provider)
        create BalanceUpdate with group = current; update = Netting with balanceChanges

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_InitiateTransfer : (ContractId TransferInProgress, ContractId AppPaymentRequest)
      with
        group : ContractId Group
        user : Party
        receiverAmounts : [ReceiverAmuletAmount]
      controller user
      do
        current <- fetch group
        assert (current.provider == provider && user `elem` (current.owner :: current.members))
        assert (all ('"\\entry -> entry.receiver "'`elem` (current.owner :: current.members)) receiverAmounts)
        now <- getTime
        request <- create AppPaymentRequest with
          sender = user
          receiverAmounts = [ReceiverAmount provider (PaymentAmount (foldl ('"\\total entry -> total + entry.amuletAmount) 0.0 receiverAmounts) AmuletUnit)]
          provider
          dso = current.dso
          expiresAt = addRelTime now (minutes 5)
          description = \"Splitwell transfer\"
        progress <- create TransferInProgress with
          group = current
          reference = request
          sender = user
          receiverAmounts
          provider
        pure (progress, request)
EOF
cd daml/splitwell && daml build"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "cat > daml/splitwell/daml/Splice/Splitwell.daml <<'EOF'
module Splice.Splitwell where

import DA.Map (Map)
import DA.Time (addRelTime, minutes)
import Splice.AmuletRules (AppTransferContext)
import Splice.Wallet.Payment

newtype GroupId = GroupId Text deriving (Eq, Show, Ord)

data GroupKey = GroupKey with
  owner : Party
  provider : Party
  id : GroupId
  deriving (Eq, Show, Ord)

getGroupKey : Group -> GroupKey
getGroupKey group = GroupKey group.owner group.provider group.id

template Group
  with
    owner : Party
    provider : Party
    members : [Party]
    id : GroupId
    dso : Party
    acceptDuration : RelTime
  where
    signatory owner, provider
    observer members

    key GroupKey owner provider id : GroupKey
    maintainer key.owner

    choice Group_Replace : ContractId Group
      with newMember : Party
      controller owner
      do
        archive self
        create this with members = members ++ [newMember]

template GroupRequest
  with group : Group
  where
    signatory group.owner
    observer group.provider

    choice GroupRequest_Accept : ContractId Group
      controller group.provider
      do create group

template GroupInvite
  with groupKey : GroupKey
  where
    signatory groupKey.owner
    observer groupKey.provider

template AcceptedGroupInvite
  with
    groupKey : GroupKey
    invitee : Party
  where
    signatory invitee
    observer groupKey.owner, groupKey.provider

data BalanceUpdateType
  = ExternalPayment with payer : Party; amount : Decimal; description : Text
  | Transfer with sender : Party; receiver : Party; amount : Decimal
  | Netting with balanceChanges : Map Party (Map Party Decimal)
  | ExtBalanceUpdateType with _dummyUnitField : ()
  deriving (Eq, Show)

template BalanceUpdate
  with
    group : Group
    update : BalanceUpdateType
  where
    signatory group.provider
    observer group.owner, group.members

template TransferInProgress
  with
    group : Group
    reference : ContractId AppPaymentRequest
    sender : Party
    receiverAmounts : [ReceiverAmuletAmount]
    provider : Party
  where
    signatory provider
    observer sender, group.owner, group.members

    choice TransferInProgress_CompleteTransfer : [ContractId BalanceUpdate]
      with transferContext : AppTransferContext
      controller provider
      do
        forA receiverAmounts "'$ '"\\ReceiverAmuletAmount{..} ->
          create BalanceUpdate with
            group
            update = Transfer with sender; receiver; amount = amuletAmount

template SplitwellRules
  with provider : Party
  where
    signatory provider

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_RequestGroup : ContractId GroupRequest
      with
        group : Group
        user : Party
      controller user
      do
        assert (group.owner == user && group.provider == provider)
        create GroupRequest with group

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_CreateInvite : ContractId GroupInvite
      with
        group : ContractId Group
        user : Party
      controller user
      do
        current <- fetch group
        assert (current.owner == user && current.provider == provider)
        create GroupInvite with groupKey = getGroupKey current

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_AcceptInvite : ContractId AcceptedGroupInvite
      with
        cid : ContractId GroupInvite
        user : Party
      controller user
      do
        invite <- fetch cid
        assert (invite.groupKey.provider == provider)
        create AcceptedGroupInvite with groupKey = invite.groupKey; invitee = user

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_Join : ContractId Group
      with
        group : ContractId Group
        cid : ContractId AcceptedGroupInvite
        user : Party
      controller user
      do
        accepted <- fetch cid
        current <- fetch group
        assert (current.owner == user && current.provider == provider)
        assert (accepted.groupKey == getGroupKey current)
        exercise group (Group_Replace accepted.invitee)

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_EnterPayment : ContractId BalanceUpdate
      with
        group : ContractId Group
        user : Party
        amount : Decimal
        description : Text
      controller user
      do
        current <- fetch group
        assert (current.provider == provider && user "'`elem` (current.owner :: current.members))
        create BalanceUpdate with
          group = current
          update = ExternalPayment with payer = user; amount; description

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_Net : ContractId BalanceUpdate
      with
        group : ContractId Group
        user : Party
        balanceChanges : Map Party (Map Party Decimal)
      controller user
      do
        current <- fetch group
        assert (current.owner == user && current.provider == provider)
        create BalanceUpdate with group = current; update = Netting with balanceChanges

    nonconsuming choice SplitwellRules_InitiateTransfer : (ContractId TransferInProgress, ContractId AppPaymentRequest)
      with
        group : ContractId Group
        user : Party
        receiverAmounts : [ReceiverAmuletAmount]
      controller user
      do
        current <- fetch group
        assert (current.provider == provider && user `elem` (current.owner :: current.members))
        assert (all ('"\\entry -> entry.receiver "'`elem` (current.owner :: current.members)) receiverAmounts)
        now <- getTime
        request <- create AppPaymentRequest with
          sender = user
          receiverAmounts = [ReceiverAmount provider (PaymentAmount (foldl ('"\\total entry -> total + entry.amuletAmount) 0.0 receiverAmounts) AmuletUnit)]
          provider
          dso = current.dso
          expiresAt = addRelTime now (minutes 5)
          description = \"Splitwell transfer\"
        progress <- create TransferInProgress with
          group = current
          reference = request
          sender = user
          receiverAmounts
          provider
        pure (progress, request)
EOF
cd daml/splitwell && daml build"

summary:
**Considering invite authorization**

I’m trying to understand if accepting an invite in Join needs authorization from the invitee. It seems the owner of the invite might consume it without duplicates. There's a process involving `AcceptedGroupInvite_Use` for the controller owner to manage this. Also, I’ll need to ensure I get the `groupKey` accepted after the exercise. It sounds a bit complex, but it’s necessary to keep everything organized during the joining process!

item.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e 's/(template AcceptedGroupInvite\\n  with\\n    groupKey : GroupKey\\n    invitee : Party\\n  where\\n    signatory invitee\\n    observer groupKey.owner, groupKey.provider\\n)/"'$1'"\\n    choice AcceptedGroupInvite_Use : AcceptedGroupInvite\\n      controller groupKey.owner\\n      do pure this\\n/; s/accepted <- fetch cid/accepted <- exercise cid AcceptedGroupInvite_Use/' daml/splitwell/daml/Splice/Splitwell.daml; (cd daml/splitwell && daml build >/tmp/splitwell-build.log 2>&1) && (cd daml/splitwell-test && daml test --files daml/Splice/Scripts/TestSplitwell.daml >/tmp/splitwell-test.log 2>&1); result="'$?; rg -n -m 1 -A 16 '"'Script execution failed|error:|Test Summary' /tmp/splitwell-test.log || tail -25 /tmp/splitwell-build.log; exit \""'$result"'
